BEFORE YOUR NEXT INTERVIEW

A few things
to know.

Where are my notes and recordings stored?

Notes and recordings are stored on your device. With Premium, signing in and enabling sync lets you access selected notes' text, summaries, and analysis results on supported devices using the same account. Original audio, video, images, and PDFs are not synced. Sync may not be available with some Premium options. Cloud transcription and AI features send data to external services for processing. For sensitive interviews, explain the workflow to your interviewee and check the applicable terms. Storage and sync details

Will it recognize names and specialist terms correctly?

Unclear audio, names, and specialist terms can produce errors. Use vocabulary registration where helpful, and check quotes against the recording. Before using an AI answer in your writing, open and verify its sources.

Can I ask about past interviews?

Yes. You can ask across multiple notes saved in Texter. The free plan allows up to 3 AI chat requests a day. This demo uses three fictional notes, but the actual feature does not require a minimum of three notes.

Do tickets give me more summaries?

No. Tickets are for file transcription. Your summary and AI chat limits stay at the free-plan allowance. Choose Premium if you need speaker labels or no daily count limit for summaries and AI chat.

Is there an Android version?

Yes. This page describes the iPhone app's features and free limits. Android features, prices, and limits differ. Check the Android app and Google Play before choosing.
